verdict.rationale: Companies House's public find-and-update service lets anyone search the register and view company data and document images. A founder can likely confirm there that a filing has been recorded or the company is registered. Its 'Follow companies' feature and live register data via the API suggest updates surface once filings are processed. However, no evidence shows a public page for tracking the status of a pending filing, application, or case. Missing for 10: explicit status tracking for in-progress or rejected filings, any case or application reference lookup, documentation of status states, and hands-on corroboration.
